[https://www.archion.de/de/alle-archive/baden-wuerttemberg/evangelisches-archiv-baden-und-wuerttemberg-wuerttemberg/dekanat-freudenstadt/baiersbronn](https://www.archion.de/de/alle-archive/baden-wuerttemberg/evangelisches-archiv-baden-und-wuerttemberg-wuerttemberg/dekanat-freudenstadt/baiersbronn)

5. Also check the **"Familienregister"** (family register) if one exists for the mid-19th century; it lists each household with both parents and all children and can confirm or add to the baptism entry.

**⚠️ Subscription required:** Viewing scans on Archion requires a paid subscription. If you hit a login/paywall prompt and cannot access the images, let me know and it will be logged as inaccessible.

---

**To capture the result:** Save the register page as a PDF (Cmd+P / Ctrl+P → Save as PDF) and upload it here — the record will then be analysed to extract the parents' names.
